blocks.text: BANGKOK – Thai police in Bangkok’s Makkasan sub-district have arrested and charged a man with causing a nuisance after a jet ski ride on Bangkok’s flooded New Phetchaburi Road. Police planned to bring the rider before a court on Sept 28. A widely circulated video showed the rider accelerating and making sharp turns, sending waves towards homes and roadside structures. News agency Tnews reported that residents’ property had been damaged, although the report did not specify the extent of the damage or identify those affected.
